g.text: CAP Theorem states that a distributed system can guarantee only two out of the

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: following three properties at the same time:

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Consistency (C)

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Availability (A)

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Partition Tolerance (P)

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: CAP Theorem

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Partition tolerance :

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Network break

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Note:When a network partition occurs,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a system must choose between

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Consistency or Availability.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | # | System / Use Case | CAP Choice | Why This Choice Is Important |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 1 | Banking system | **CP** | Financial data must always be correct; system may reject requests during partition |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 2 | Stock trading platform | **CP** | Incorrect price or trade execution can cause huge financial loss |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 3 | Distributed databases (strong consistency mode) | **CP** | Data integrity across nodes is critical |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 4 | Airline reservation system | **CP** | Prevents double seat booking |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 5 | Configuration management system | **CP** | All services must read the same configuration |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 6 | Social media feed | **AP** | Slightly stale posts are acceptable if the platform remains available |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 7 | DNS system | **AP** | DNS must always respond even if records are slightly outdated |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 8 | Online shopping cart | **AP** | Cart must remain accessible even during replication delays |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 9 | Messaging systems | **AP** | System should continue delivering messages even during temporary failures |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 10 | News / content websites | **AP** | Serving slightly outdated content is acceptable |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | 11 | Single-server SQL database | **CA** | No distributed network; system can maintain both consistency and availability |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
